text: ぼうえんきょうを　のぞいた…　おおきな　とりが　キラキラ　ひかりながら　うみの　ほうへ　とんでいく…

structure.jp: ぼうえんきょうを　のぞいた…
キラキラ　ひかりながら

patterns.name: 〜ながら
patterns.explanation: ながら after a verb says two things happen at the same time. ひかりながら = 'while shining'.

patterns.name: 〜ていく
patterns.explanation: いく after a て-form verb says the action moves away from where you are. とんでいく = 'flies off'.

patterns.name: 〜のほうへ
patterns.explanation: のほうへ after a place says 'in the direction of' it, not exactly to it. うみの　ほうへ = 'toward the sea'.
